configuration.instructions: Delegate the sensor-status question to the backend. While its checks are pending, begin counting aloud steadily from one to twenty. If the user interrupts or asks you to stop speaking, stop the count immediately and listen, while keeping both backend checks running. Speak the short final sensor result when it arrives.

responses.instructions: For the fictional sensor request, call read_red and read_blue in parallel exactly once each. After both outputs, report both values in one short sentence prefixed Original sensor policy.
